text:
julia: Quick ask  can someone build a compact, manager-facing hybrid onboarding cheat-sheet (day0-day7 + copy-paste 30/60/90 bullets) that we can DM to hiring managers? New SRE starts Wed. Need to include logistics for pickup vs shipping, badge/QR entry, timezone-aware scheduling, and a short list of manager-only actions.
omar: I'll sketch a one-pager. Must-haves: confirm laptop ship/pickup, pre-provision VPN/SSO, assign buddy, calendar templates for first week + skip-level, and who opens infra tickets. Also add a line about workstation ergonomics voucher (we give $75 for monitors/stands).
neha: Add: set expectations for async onboarding for remote-first days (reading pack + recorded architecture walkthroughs), request access to monitoring & alerting groups, and pick an initial on-call overlap day. Also require confirmation that PR review access is granted within 48h.
it-queue: IT logistics: imaging windows Wed 810am (Bldg E) and Tue 5pm push. Image tag `rwi-sre-onboard-1.4`. For shipping choose UPS 2-day; include field on intake for OS preference (mac/linux). Pre-create email alias and slack account if intake is complete by Fri. Quick snippet managers can copy to IT:```
Provision request: 
- name: {name} 
- email: {email} 
- teams: infra,sre 
- os: mac 
- tools: datadog,grafana,github,slack 
```
julia: Also want manager-only bullets: 1) schedule Day1 buddy + 4x 1:1s for week1, 2) set a 30-min architecture walkthrough with tech lead, 3) book a 30-min desk/setup with IT or confirm shipping, 4) add "OKR alignment" checkbox to first-month goals, 5) confirm ergonomics voucher processed.
omar: Calendar snippets (pasteable):
```
Day1 09:00-09:30: Welcome + Setup (Manager + IT + Buddy)
Day1 10:00-10:30: Team intro + standup (All)
Day2 14:00-15:00: Architecture walkthrough (Tech lead)
Day4 11:00-11:30: 30-day goals sync (Manager + New hire)
Week1 Fri 16:00-16:30: Week1 retro + feedback
```
neha: 30/60/90 copyable (manager version, measurable):
- 30: "By 30 days: on-call shadow completed, 2 infra PRs merged, monitoring alerts understood, and a short learning plan for next 60 days."
- 60: "By 60 days: own a small service patch, reduce mean time to acknowledge for owned alerts by 10%, complete 60-day learning milestones."
- 90: "By 90 days: lead a postmortem, propose one reliability improvement with metrics, and be independently onboarded to on-call rotations."
it-queue: Badge & building notes: we support QR entry and physical badges. Badge pickup windows: Wed 8:30	10:30 & Thu 14:00	16:00 at Security. If remote-first week, manager should pre-register email so we can pre-approve QR check-in. Also include parking voucher instructions for those driving.
peopleops-bot: Reminder: intake form must capture shipping address, OS preference, in-office days, breakfast RSVP, travel reimbursement needed (Y/N), and time zone. People Ops will auto-enroll new hire in #new-hires and security training once form is submitted.
julia: DM templates managers can use: Day0 DM to hire: "Hey <name> 00% excited to have you join! Pickup laptop: Wed 8:30-10:30 (Bldg E reception) or we can ship to your address (reply with preference). Bring ID for badge. First day 9:00am: quick setup with IT + 30-min intro with me. I'll send calendar invites.  <manager>"
note: include a shorter internal manager-to-manager DM to confirm buddy: "Hi <buddy>  can you buddy for <name> week1? please join Day1 setup at 9am and do codebase walkthrough on Day2."
omega: (typo correction) omar: please update intake to ask about timezone-specific overlap hours so managers can plan 1:1s if hire is in +8 or -5.
julia: Good catch. Also add a short "what success looks like at 30 days" blurb managers can paste into goals: "Confident deploying small fixes with approval, merged 2 PRs, completed key training, and presented a 30-day learning plan."
neha: Suggest adding an item: allocate 1 hour of deep-dive pairing with the person who owns the primary service in week2. Helps ramping fast.
omar: I'll include a tiny checklist for managers to mark complete and a simple calendar ICS bundle. Also include note about welcome swag drop: ops can coordinate a desk swag pack if in-office.
badge-bot: Action: Pre-approve badge when manager provides employee email in intake. Also confirm parking voucher redemption steps.
peopleops-bot: Action items created: (1) Publish manager cheat-sheet -> omar, (2) Update intake to add timezone & OS preference -> people-ops, (3) Create calendar ICS template -> julia. Due: today 5:00pm.
julia: Thanks team 44d please review the draft when I post it in 20m.
neha: will review 44d
